### Graphs

#### Predictions 

Function computing P(e|c) under the generative CCCF CBN

```{r}
p_ec_cccf <- function(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c, check = TRUE) {
  if (check) {
    if (any(is.na(c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c))))
      stop("Inputs must not be NA.")
    
    if (any(c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c) < 0 | 
            c(w_ce, w_ae, w_ac, b_a, b_c) > 1)) {
      warning("Inputs are typically probabilities/weights in [0, 1]. Proceeding anyway.")
    }

    denom <- w_ac*b_a + b_c - w_ac*b_c*b_a
    if (isTRUE(all.equal(denom, 0)))
      stop("Invalid inputs: denominator equals 0 (division by zero).")
  }

  numerator   <- w_ac*b_a + b_c*b_a - w_ac*b_c*b_a
  denominator <- w_ac*b_a + b_c - w_ac*b_c*b_a

  w_ce + (1 - w_ce) * w_ae * (numerator / denominator)
}

```

```{r}
  w_ae = 0.9,
  w_ac = 0.9,

) -> prediction_cccf_bc_1
prediction_cccf_bc_1
```

Function computing P(e|c) under the simple common effect CBN 

```{r}
p_ec_icce <- function(w_ce, b_a, w_ae, check = TRUE) {

  if (check) {
    if (any(is.na(c(w_ce, b_a, w_ae))))
      stop("Inputs must not be NA.")
    
    if (any(c(w_ce, b_a, w_ae) < 0 | 
            c(w_ce, b_a, w_ae) > 1)) {
      warning("Inputs are typically probabilities/weights in [0,1]. Proceeding anyway.")
    }
  }

  w_ce + (1 - w_ce) * b_a * w_ae
}

```


for b_c = 0.2

```{r}
p_ec_icce(
  w_ce = 0.3,
  b_a  = 0.2,
  w_ae = 0.9
)-> prediction_icce_bc_1
prediction_icce_bc_1
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
# Ensure RColorBrewer is loaded for professional palettes
library(RColorBrewer) 

# 1. Setup Fonts
font_add_google("Outfit", "title_font")
font_add_google("Cabin", "body_font")
showtext_auto()

# 2. Plotting
g3 <- ggplot(tdata_sub, aes(x = case, y = rating, fill = structure, color = structure)) +
  # Faceting
  facet_wrap(~ parameter + structure, 
             labeller = label_both, 
             nrow = 1) +
  
  # Data Layers: Background Jittered Lines
  geom_line(aes(group = subj_code), 
            position = position_jitter(height = 0.02, width = 0.05), 
            linewidth = 0.4, 
            alpha = 0.1) +
  
  # Distribution: Subtle Violins
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2, color = NA, trim = TRUE) +
  
  # Summary Layers: Now using the 'structure' color mapping
  # 1. Error bars (Black for contrast, or match structure)
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), 
               fun.data = mean_cl_boot, 
               geom = "errorbar", 
               width = 0, 
               linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # 2. Connecting Line (Matched to structure color)
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), 
               fun = mean, 
               geom = "line", 
               linewidth = 1.2, 
               alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # 3. Mean Points (Large and prominent)
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), 
               fun = mean, 
               geom = "point", 
               shape = 21, 
               size = 4, 
               stroke = 1.2,
               fill = "white") + # White fill makes the color 'pop'
  
  # Model Predictions: Distinct black squares
  geom_point(data = preds_plot, 
             aes(x = case, y = prediction), 
             color = "black", 
             fill = "black", 
             size = 2.5, 
             shape = 22) + 

  # Scales & Professional Color Palette (Set2)
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), 
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Parameter Value", 
       y = expression(bold(paste("P(e|c) Rating")))) +
  
  # Use a qualitative palette designed for publications
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  
  # Styling
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "body_font"),
    # Facet Strips: Cleaned up for a modern look
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, family = "title_font"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    
    # Axes and Grid
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    
    # Remove legend as requested
    legend.position = "none"
  )
g3
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest) # Adds p-values to lmer

# Model prediction error while accounting for the random intercept of each subject
model <- lmer(rating ~ structure*parameter*case + (1 | subj_code), data =  tdata_sub)

summary(model)
anova(model)
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)

# 1. Calculate Estimated Marginal Means for the Case effect 
# specifically for parameter "ba", grouped by structure.
em_ba <- emmeans(model, ~ case | structure, at = list(parameter = "ba"))

# 2. Compare Case 0.9 vs Case 0.2 within each structure.
# Using 'reverse = TRUE' will calculate (Case 0.9 - Case 0.2) 
# assuming 0.9 is the later level alphabetically/factor-wise.
ba_contrasts <- pairs(em_ba, reverse = FALSE)

# 3. Display the results with confidence intervals and p-values
summary(ba_contrasts, infer = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)

# 1. Estimate marginal means for 'case' within 'structure', specifically for 'bc'
em_bc <- emmeans(model, ~ case | structure, at = list(parameter = "bc"))

# 2. Perform the pairwise comparisons (Case 0.9 vs Case 0.2)
# reverse = TRUE gives you (Case 0.9 - Case 0.2)
bc_contrasts <- pairs(em_bc, reverse = TRUE)

# 3. View the results with significance tests
summary(bc_contrasts, infer = TRUE)
```


# Clusters 

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- 2. Define the Margin of Error ---
margin_of_error <- 3 # 3% margin (scale from 0 to 100)

# --- 3. Cluster Participants ---
tdata_clusters <- tdata %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate the difference for easier understanding
    rating_difference = case_09 - case_02,
    
    cluster = case_when(
      # Condition 1: No change (absolute difference is within the margin)
      # This condition must come FIRST to give precedence to the margin
      abs(rating_difference) <= margin_of_error ~ "no change",
      
      # Condition 2: Increase 
      rating_difference > margin_of_error ~ "increase",
      
      # Condition 3: Decrease
      rating_difference < -margin_of_error ~ "decrease",
      
      # Optional: A catch-all for any cases not covered (shouldn't happen with these conditions)
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
    )
  )



tdata_clusters$structure <- factor(tdata_clusters$structure, levels = c("ic", "cccf"), 
                          labels = c("icce", "cccf"))

tdata_clusters$parameter<- factor(tdata_clusters$parameter, levels = c("bc", "ba"), 
                     labels = c("bc", "ba"))


```

create the data frame with the counts

```{r}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(binom)

cluster_summary <- tdata_clusters %>%
  count(structure, parameter, cluster, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(structure, parameter) %>%
  mutate(
    n_total = sum(n),
    p = n / n_total,
    percentage = 100 * p
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Wilson 95% CI for each bar
  bind_cols(
    binom.confint(
      x = .$n,
      n = .$n_total,
      methods = "wilson"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        ci_low  = 100 * lower,
        ci_high = 100 * upper
      )
  )
```

```{r}
            linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2, color = NA, trim = TRUE) +
  
  # Summary: Color-matched lines and points
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", width = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.1) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2, fill = "white") +
  
  # Model Predictions (Black squares)
  geom_point(data = preds_plot, aes(x = case, y = prediction), 
             color = "black", fill = "black", size = 2.2, shape = 22) + 

  # Scales & Labels
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pub_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pub_palette) +
  labs(x = "Parameter Value", y = expression(bold(paste("P(e|c) Rating")))) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "body_font"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "grey92"), # Slightly darker for more 'structure'
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, family = "title_font"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# 3. Updated Bar Plot (G4)
g4 <- ggplot(clusters_plot, aes(x = cluster, y = percentage, fill = structure)) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter + structure, labeller = label_both, nrow = 1) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.85, color = NA) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6, color = "grey20") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 0), "%")), vjust = -1.2, family = "body_font", size = 3.2) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 115), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pub_palette) + # Same palette!
  
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Percentage (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "body_font"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "grey92"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, family = "title_font"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8, family = "body_font"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

g3
g4
```
